title: High Purity High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction from Fungal Tissues
author: Ramawatar Nagar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rzkd74w
materials: preparation and sequencing on a FLO-MIN-106 (R9.

To measure the intact double-stranded DNA concentration, use a fluorometric assay kit such as Qubit (Invitrogen) or Quantus (Promega). To access purity use a UV spectrophotometer like Nanodrop and observe the 260/280, 260/230 ratios and concentration. Ideally, pure DNA should have a 260/280, 1.8 and, 260/230, 2.0-2.2 and the concentration measured by both fluorometric assay and spectrophotometer should be 1:1 to 1:1.5. The CTAB precipitated, 2 V SPRI beads wash DNA meets these purity standards (Table 1) and gives a NanoDrop absorbance spectrum typical of pure DNA. To visually inspect the DNA, run a regular 0.8 % TBE agarose gel and observe the DNA sample for any residual RNA and other contamination, moslty found at the bottom of the gel. Load ~ 50-100 ng dsDNA along with 100 ng Hind-III cut lambda DNA ladder. To access the DNA molecules size distribution, run a pulse field gel. steps.title: Prepare CTAB Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the CTAB lysis buffer (pH 8) containing 100 mM Tris, 20 mM EDTA, 2% w/v CTAB, and 1.2 M NaCl. For every 100 mg of spores, take 5 mL of this buffer and add 1.0% (v/v) PVP, 1.0% (w/v) Cellulase, 1.0% (v/v) Pectinases, and 1.0% (w/v) Macerozyme.

steps.title: Grind Fungal Spores
steps.instruction: Grind 100 mg of spores with 2 g of acid-washed autoclaved sand using liquid nitrogen to maintain a frozen state.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 g acid-washed autoclaved sand to a clean sterile mortar.
Slowly add pure liquid nitrogen and let it dissipate twice.
Add 100 mg spores to the mortar once the liquid N2 is gone.
Mix spores and sand with a pestle, adding more liquid N2 quickly once mixed.
Grind spores 3-4 times in 10-15 second bursts, adding liquid nitrogen each time, avoiding excessive pressure to prevent DNA shearing.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Lyse the ground spores and digest proteins using Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the ground spores to a 50 mL Falcon tube containing the assembled CTAB lysis buffer.
Add 50 µL of Proteinase K (stock concentration 20 mg/mL).
Incubate for 1.5 hours at room temperature on a rotator at 30 rpm.

steps.title: First Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform an initial organic extraction to remove proteins and lipids.

substeps.instruction: Add one volume (5 mL) of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1).
Mix well by inverting the tube 10-15 times.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 5000g at room temperature.

steps.title: RNA Degradation
steps.instruction: Remove RNA from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the aqueous phase to a new 50 mL tube.
Add 5 µL RNase T (1000 U/µL).
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes on a tube rotator at 30 rpm.

steps.title: Second Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol Extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the organic extraction to further purify the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add one volume (5 mL) of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1).
Mix well by inverting the tube 100 times.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 5000g at room temperature.

steps.title: CTAB-DNA Complex Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the CTAB-DNA complex using CTAB precipitation buffer (pH 8: 100 mM TrisHCl, 20 mM EDTA, 2% w/v CTAB).

substeps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 50 mL tube.
Add 2 volumes of CTAB precipitation buffer and mix well by inverting.
Place the tube in a rotating hybridization oven or temperature control rotator at 55 °C for 30 minutes, or until white crystals of CTAB-DNA complex are observed floating.

steps.title: Pellet Recovery and Washing
steps.instruction: Recover the CTAB-DNA complex pellet and remove excess salts.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16,000g for 5 minutes at room temperature to pellet crystals.
Carefully pipette off the supernatant.
Add ~5 mL freshly prepared 70% EtOH, invert multiple times, and let the pellet soak for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 16,000g for 5 minutes and carefully pipette off the supernatant.

steps.title: Crude DNA Dissolution
steps.instruction: Dry and dissolve the pellet to obtain crude DNA.

substeps.instruction: Air dry the pellet for 10-15 minutes until ethanol evaporates.
Dissolve the pellet in 500 µL 10 mM Tris (pH 8.0) and transfer to a 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Secondary Purification of Crude DNA
steps.instruction: Treat the crude DNA with RNase and Proteinase K to remove residual impurities.

substeps.instruction: Add ~5 µL RNase T (100 U/µL) to the 500 µL crude DNA and incubate at room temperature on a horizontal shaker at 400 rpm for 1 hour.
Add 10 µL Proteinase K and incubate at room temperature on a horizontal shaker at 400 rpm for 1 hour.
Add an equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) and mix 100 times slowly by hand.
Centrifuge at 5000g for 10 minutes and transfer the upper aqueous phase into a fresh 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation and Final Wash
steps.instruction: Precipitate and wash the purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) to the aqueous phase and mix well.
Precipitate DNA by adding an equal volume of isopropanol.
Centrifuge at 5000g for 10 minutes to pellet the DNA.
Pipette off the supernatant and wash the pellet with freshly prepared 70% ethanol twice.
Centrifuge briefly after the second wash and remove all remaining ethanol with a pipette.
Add 200 µL 10 mM Tris (pH 8) to the pellet and dissolve overnight.

steps.title: SPRI Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Use SPRI beads to remove residual RNAs, small oligos, and contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.6 V of PEG/NaCl-SPRI bead solution to the DNA and mix well by horizontal shaking or gentle flicking for 5 minutes.
Place the mix on a magnet block until beads settle at the wall.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube and add additional SPRI beads solution to reach a final DNA:beads ratio of 1:2.
Mix on a horizontal rotator for 5 minutes.
Place on a magnet block until beads settle.
Remove the supernatant and wash the pellet with freshly prepared 70% ethanol twice.
Air dry the pellet for 30-40 seconds.
Dissolve the pellet in 100 µL 10 mM Tris pH 8.
